notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM save and restore state. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, HLAinteger32BE, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies HLAfederateState transitions and callback/reflection metadata across save and restore without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation save/restore controls and FederateAmbassador joined-federate MOM state delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador save/restore/MOM declarations
